assertions.assert: <device:snapshot> takes exactly location and target, both present and not empty, and no content, and the namespace has no other element: a malformed element raises error.execution and assigns nothing (its schema, package/device.xsd, rejects it before any run under scx validate).

<device:snapshot> writes {id, state, attributes, events} of the session its target names: its _sessionid (for an invoked child, <parent _sessionid>.<invokeid>), its active atomic states in document order separated by one space, its data model by <data> id, and the event names its active transitions accept, each once, a descriptor * naming none.
A target that no running session of the run answers assigns nothing and raises nothing: location keeps its value.
